data.prompt: Fix fill-to-threshold suggestion cards UI bugs: broken images and non-clickable links (especially for NL/non-US countries). Root causes: (1) checker.go hardcodes amazon.com for alt URLs, (2) Decodo markdown may return empty image_url, (3) fallback items have url:undefined. Also create integration sanity tests, wire into auto-launch.sh, and create GitHub Actions CI workflow for PR validation.
